facts.fact: The Internet Society Benin chapter's study treats the Déclaration de Politique Sectorielle (DPS) as the government's operative digital-sector strategy and recommends that the State update it to make affordable quality internet access a priority axis; no adoption date is given, so the study's publication month is used.
The study cites the DPS text at numerique.gouv.bj/assets/Documents/DPS.pdf, an official ministry site; the date is the study's publication month.

The study summarises the DPS as setting targets of 80% broadband coverage of businesses and individuals, 100% of schools connected, a top-100 Network Readiness Index rank, and a first phase of about 2,000 km of backbone linking 67 communes and 280 km of Grand Cotonou metropolitan loop, with no cost stated; the date is the study's publication month.
